source_version.description: Weaviate version of the source cluster

target_version.description: Weaviate version of the target cluster

source_nodes.description: Node names from the source cluster

target_nodes.description: Node names in the target cluster

changes.description: Every modification applied to the descriptor for target compatibility

type.description: Category of the change (e.g. vectorizer_change, shard_reassigned, replication_factor_reduced, cache_limit_reduced, owning_node_changed, tenant_reassigned)

warnings.description: Data integrity concerns and conditions that require attention after restore

type.description: Category of warning (e.g. dimension_change, replica_inconsistency, new_replica_needed)

errors.description: Constraints that could not be automatically resolved — entities excluded from the migrated descriptor

message.description: Human-readable description of the unresolvable constraint
